items.prompt: The scan has consumed "aaabb" but has not reached the end of input. Its tokens list is ["a3"]. What pending state must (previous,count) hold?

options.why: That run has already been emitted. The pending state must describe the final adjacent run of the consumed prefix, not the last emitted token.
The last two consumed characters form the unfinished b run. Completed a3 is already stored separately.
Both final b characters have been consumed, so resetting to 1 here loses one member of the pending run.
Count is a run length, not the number of all consumed characters, and the current character is b.
